name: qkd_ke_rq_ref

job.purpose: q13-kvleaves: hard tile of the thin-cluster KV end (ot_qkvd_kv_end SPL=1) -- FDI RX capture: rx_v/rx_flit pin flops, four per-buffer word relays and push flops (2,665 flops). M5 leaf, every face pin registered, own clock root.
job.structural_change: kv_end thin cluster: ot_qkvd_d2d's own 11.5k registers are cut into hard pin-registered tiles with their own clock roots (ke_ti x3, ke_rq, ke_tm, ke_tf, ke_ro x4, ke_ctl, ke_wf); the cluster keeps no register and only distributes the clock to child clock pins (flat parents qkd_d2d_ref-q10 / qkd_d2d_pf_ref-q13: one root over 11.5k registers + hard buffers, spine insertion 2.07-2.5 ns, FF hold -142 / -216, DRC 31 / 35); ke_rq pin plan: the four buffer copies of every word bit on adjacent S-face pins and rx_flit[i] straight above (explicit io_tcl, columns in the sbufp din order), so the 1:4 fan-out is a local column (q16: four 71-um bus ranges, 528 nets crossing a 17-um core, cut 0.63: incremental global route stuck > 25 min)
